description: Header file defining constants, structures, and function prototypes for the TMD2620 proximity sensor driver in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: tmd2620_setup_int
methods.description: Configures the interrupt pin for the TMD2620 sensor.

methods.name: tmd2620_work_cb
methods.description: Callback function for handling sensor work, if trigger is enabled.

methods.name: tmd2620_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes for the TMD2620 device.

methods.name: tmd2620_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets trigger handlers for the TMD2620 sensor.
